items.label: Global Standard Technology Q2 FY2026 (08-14-2026)

set.signal: H1 2026 (DART half-year report, consolidated, reviewed by Ichon Accounting): revenue KRW 215,130M, which the company says is about 24% above H1 2025 (KRW 169,780,007,084), and operating profit KRW 35,651M, about 32% higher (H1 2025: KRW 28,005,339,411). Q2 alone revenue was KRW 99,243,908,463 (Q2 2025: KRW 97,438,094,351) while Q2 operating profit fell to KRW 15,459,264,221 from KRW 18,109,955,560; warranty (defect-repair) expense for the half rose to KRW 16,126,864 thousand from KRW 8,294,212 thousand. Mix: scrubbers KRW 136,326,659 thousand (63.4%), chillers KRW 37,739,090 thousand (17.5%), services 16.8% and merchandise 2.3%; exports were 61.6% of revenue. The average scrubber price rose to KRW 144,315 thousand per unit from KRW 135,999 thousand in FY2025. R&D spend was KRW 9,957M, 4.8% of parent revenue and up 39.3% year on year.

items.reason: The filing does not attribute the Q2 operating-profit decline to warranty expense; state the two facts separately (no inferred causation)

items.label: HaeSung DS Q2 FY2026 (08-14-2026)

set.signal: Customers (DART half-year report): package-substrate customers are mainly Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix, served at their Korean and Chinese plants; leadframe customers are IDMs Infineon, ST Micro and NXP and OSATs ASE, Amkor, SPIL, JCET and UTAC. The company withholds each customer's revenue share. Two unnamed customers each exceeded 10% of consolidated revenue in H1 2026: KRW 49,476,635 thousand (share 0.1238) and KRW 44,810,728 thousand (0.1121), against shares of 0.1311 and 0.1302 a year earlier. Orders are placed for delivery within 1~2 months with volumes and prices set monthly or quarterly, so no backlog is disclosed and there is no long-term supply contract.

items.label: HaeSung DS Q2 FY2026 (08-14-2026)
items.signal_prefix: Capacity and investment (DART half-year report): w

set.signal: Capacity and investment (DART half-year report): with 557 production tools, H1 2026 output was 26,328,492 Kpcs against capacity of 47,600,043 Kpcs, utilisation 55.3% (FY2025: 48.9%; strip basis 51.4% against 46.3%). H1 investment of KRW 8,393M went to a new manufacturing building, etching equipment and CO2 laser drills to meet rising customer demand, and the company says this is extending its substrate business from existing memory packages into mobile DRAM, graphics DRAM and NAND flash packages. The board approved a BGA (package-substrate) capacity expansion investment on 2026-05-29 and a budget increase for an AI-based BGA final-inspection process; the Changwon facility expansion program, revised to KRW 252,500,000,000, runs to 2026-11-30.
